title: Synaptics CRA Compliance Framework
summary: Synaptics CRA Compliance Framework Synaptics CRA Story What is the Cyber Resilience Act (CRA)? The Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) is a European Union regulation that establishes mandatory cybersecurity requirements for products with digital elements, including hardware, software, and connected devices. The CRA aims to ensure products are secure by design, supported throughout their lifecycle, and better protected against evolving cyber threats Learn More about CRA Synaptics CRA Compliance Framework End-to-end security lifecycle helping customers build, certify and support CRA-compliant products. Secure by Design Security engineered from concept through architecture, implementation and verification. Risk Assessment Identify, prioritize and mitigate cybersecurity risks throughout the lifecycle. Vulnerability Handling SBOM, vulnerability tracking, remediation and security testing. PSIRT Manage vulnerability disclosure and customer security communications. Secure Updates Develop, validate and deliver security updates throughout the product support lifecycle. Lifecycle & Compliance Maintain compliance through documentation, monitoring and product lifecycle support. Synaptics Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL) Security is embedded in Synaptics engineering processes to deliver secure, reliable and CRA-compliant products Security Activities Across the Lifecycle Requirement Security requirement definition Regulatory & customer requirement review Security feature planning Architecture & Design Security architectural reviews The threat modeling Attack surface and trust boundary analysis Implementation Secure coding practice Pier code reviews Static analysis (Klocwork & SonarQube) Open-source component review Verification & Validation Functional security test testing Vulnerability scanning Penetration testing Release Approval Security review and vulnerability assessment Open issue reviews S bomb generation and release sign off Maintenance & Update Vulnerability monitoring Security advisory review Patch development and secure updates Security update Lifecycle Vulnerability Identified: Any vulnerability detected from internal, customer, supplier or public sources PSIRT Assessment: Vulnerability triage, validate, and assess impact and priority following the defined PSIRT process Implementation: Develop and integrated security fixes and mitigation Verification & Validation: Validate fix and perform quality and security testing Image Signing: Sign release and create update packages Secure OTA: Deploy update securely to the devices Customer Benefits Industrial tools used in dev. process Release traceability Continuous Security Improvement Integrated process for delivering security updates Secure OTA process based on HW RoT extension Close customer engagement and collaboration Secure By Design Synaptics applies security-by-design principles embedded across architecture and development lifecycle and are aligned to industry best practices.
